description: 4-layer dual 3-phase BLDC motor driver board for an autonomous Eurobot SIMA robot. Integrates two TI MCT8314ZH sensored BLDC motor drivers (U201, U301) powered from a +6V battery rail with 3-phase JST-XH motor outputs (J202, J302), JST-GH Hall-sensor connectors (J201, J301), BSS138 low-side auxiliary actuator MOSFETs (Q1, Q2), diagnostic status LEDs, and a 2x10 board-to-board control header (J1).

power_rails.notes: Main motor supply rail feeding both TI MCT8314ZH BLDC motor drivers (U201, U301) and auxiliary MOSFETs
3.3V logic and Hall-sensor/pull-up supply rail from 2x10 board-to-board connector (J1)
Internal 5V regulator/Hall supply output of left MCT8314ZH driver (U201)
Internal 5V regulator/Hall supply output of right MCT8314ZH driver (U301)

design_requirements.decoupling_guidance: Place charge-pump (0.22uF), VREG/LDO (2.2uF), and VM bulk/bypass (10uF, 100nF) capacitors tightly adjacent to U201 and U301 (MCT8314ZH), and keep three-phase output traces (U/V/W) short and wide to J202/J302.
